profile.name: Paul Caucheteux
profile.biography: I am a first-year PhD student at [CREST](https://crest.science/) / [ENSAE Paris](https://www.ensae.fr/), under the supervision of [Anna Korba](https://akorba.github.io/) and [Clément Bonet](https://clbonet.github.io/). My research interests include generative modeling, optimization over probability distributions, and Wasserstein gradient flows.

publications.title: A Unifying View of Variational Generative Wasserstein Flows

presentations.title: A Unifying View of Variational Generative Wasserstein Flows

paragraphs: I teach tutorials at ENSAE Paris. I taught Optimization to third-year students (3A) in 2025–2026 and am teaching it again in 2026–2027. I am also teaching Fondements mathématiques des probabilités in 2026–2027.
